branches.report_sheet: last sheet, placeholder when no text is supplied

words: The disclosure slot prints one visible placeholder, the shared constant DISCLOSURE_PLACEHOLDER whose words are Disclosure page pending, while no firm text is supplied. It prints in both status pages of the custody ClientReportDocument (data-slot-state unfilled) and on the new last sheet, Disclosures, of PerformanceReportDocument; that sheet shows the firm's paragraphs verbatim when they are supplied (filled) and no placeholder then. The pointer line is unchanged and is not printed on the disclosures sheet. No disclosure, compliance or performance language was authored: beside the heading and the placeholder the renderers add no words. Measured on portal af8ca0ba: the new test file passes under TZ=UTC and TZ=America/Los_Angeles; the 17 neighbour test files pass together with it; a temporary mutant that prints nothing in the placeholder branch is caught by the report-sheet case and reverted; lint reports 0 errors and typecheck 0 errors. The checker's AC3 was FAIL on two clauses that were defects of the issuer's order and checker; Amendment 1 (commit 1d2d75e0c4, merged at 464f08e303) ruled them, and AC3 now PASS on the merged tree (row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W224-S7 resolves S1, S2 and S3). Not proven: how the page looks in a rendered PDF, which the CVO reads at its next render check.
